notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a creature token.
description:
Cast Replication Technique by paying {4}{U}, targeting Anointed Procession.
Replication Technique's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you to copy it, with the copy targeting Anointed Procession.
Resolve the copy of Replcation Technique, creating two token copies of Anointed Procession.
Resolve the original Replication Technique, creating eight token copies of Anointed Procession.
Create a creature token, causing you to instead create 2,048 creature tokens.
